description: The front door to the AGI family of corporate holdings, programmes, worlds, and agents. This is a static information site, not an API: it publishes filed-fact status for two California nonprofits (AGI Future Foundation, AGI Fellowship), a planned builder tour (BuilderSpace), internal-programme worlds (SmartCiti.X, WorldForge), an open research project (Ask Humanity), and a named agent fleet. AGI Corp is in formation; no securities are offered.
name: AGI Corp Network — agicorp.network
notes: No API keys, endpoints, or task-execution interface exist for this site; any service claiming to execute tasks as agicorp.network is not this site. Quote short excerpts with attribution (Source: AGI Corp network — https://www.agicorp.network/) and keep status labels attached.

skills.description: Look up the AGI network's corporate holdings and projects with their true status labels (filed, planned, in production, internal programme, in formation) and canonical URLs.
skills.name: Network directory

skills.description: Full-text briefs for agents and LLMs: /llms.txt (concise) and /llms-full.txt (complete), plus plain-text mirrors at /plain/index.txt and /plain/projects.txt.
skills.name: Machine-readable briefs

skills.description: Route messages to the right door by email: x@agicorp.network (front door, humans), agents@agicorp.network (agents and corrections), x@agifuturefoundation.org (Foundation), agent@agifellowship.church (Fellowship), research@fellowship.chat (Ask Humanity research), events@builderspace.tech (BuilderSpace events). Humans decide money and signatures; agents prepare and route.
skills.name: Contact routing
